When the sky splits open.
And it obeys its Lord, as it must.
And when the earth is stretched out flat.
And it throws out what is inside it and is empty.
And it obeys its Lord, as it must.
O human, you are working hard to get to your Lord, and you will meet Him.
The one who is given his book in his right hand.
Will have an easy time.
And he will go back to his family happy.
But the one who is given his book behind his back.
Will cry out: Oh no, I am lost!
And he will go into a blazing fire.
He used to be happy with his family.
He thought he would never go back to Allah.
Yes, he will! His Lord was always watching him.
Allah swears by the red glow after sunset.
And by the night and all it gathers.
And by the moon when it is full.
You will go from one step to the next step.
So what is wrong with them that they do not believe?
And when the Quran is read to them, they do not bow down?
But those who say no keep on saying it is a lie.
And Allah knows best what they hide in their hearts.
So give them the news of a painful punishment.
Except for people who believe and do good. They will have a reward that never ends.
